nodes.description: Core protocol storage: epoch, balance, provider, accounts, epochs, candidates mappings.
DIP-13 storage: coupon underlying accounting and cached oracle price.
DIP-16 storage: legacy oracle and sushiswap pool epoch start.
EIP-1967 proxy implementation slot read via assembly sload and written in setImplementation.
External state-transition entrypoint running Bonding/Regulator/Market step and incentivizing the caller.
Modifier that measures gas used and mints an advance reward to msg.sender using Chainlink prices.
Initializer guarded by initializer modifier that configures oracle/pool and mints seed balances.
Bonds staged dollars for stake, using totalBonded/totalSupply to price the stake.
Converts bonded stake back into staged dollars proportionally.
Unbonds a dollar amount, computing balanced burned stake.
Pulls dollars via transferFrom and credits staged balance.
Transfers dollars out and reduces staged balance, gated by onlyFrozenOrLocked.
External entrypoint that burns debt for coupons and splits them into expiring/reclaimable parts.
External entrypoint redeeming coupon underlying when price is in expansion, applying penalties.
Governance voting that can nominate a candidate and lock the voter's stake.
Commits a passed governance proposal, upgrading the proxy to the candidate implementation.
Super-majority emergency proposal commit that upgrades the proxy implementation.
Internal upgrade routine that stores the implementation and delegatecalls its initialize().
Mints dollars to an account and increases recorded debt outside bootstrapping.
Distributes new supply across pool, treasury, redeemable and DAO while tracking rewards.
Reads the external oracle price with bootstrapping fallbacks.
Computes the coupon redemption penalty from block.timestamp and coupon age.
Moves coupon underlying between accounts with allowance checks for delegated callers.
Invariant check comparing dollar balance held to bonded+staged+redeemable liabilities.
Caller-controlled address used for minting incentives, voting, coupon and bonding operations.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for epoch timing and coupon penalty decay.
delegatecall into the candidate implementation of initialize(), executing arbitrary code in proxy context.
dollar().mint(msg.sender, incentive.value) state-changing external call inside the incentivized modifier.
External call minting dollars on the IDollar token contract.
External transferFrom pulling user dollars into the protocol.
External call to oracle().capture() whose result drives supply expansion/contraction.
User-supplied dollar amount used for coupon purchase.
User-supplied staged amount to bond.
User-supplied candidate implementation address for commit.
New implementation address passed to upgradeTo.
Epoch identifier of the coupons being redeemed.
gasleft() snapshot used to compute the advance incentive.
Computed DSD incentive amount minted to the caller.

edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose coupons are minted in purchaseCoupons.
msg.sender supplies the coupon underlying redeemed in redeemCoupons.
msg.sender staged balance is bonded.
msg.sender unbonds stake.
msg.sender vote weight is recorded in vote.
msg.sender allowance is applied when transferring coupons for a sender.
msg.sender receives the minted advance incentive via mintToAccount.
Redemption penalty depends on block.timestamp modulo the epoch period.
advance emits block.timestamp and relies on current time for epoch transitions.
User amount flows into coupon premium and balanceOfCoupons division arithmetic.
User value flows into stake multiplier/ratio arithmetic in bond.
User supplied candidate is validated and passed to upgradeTo.
User supplied implementation address is stored and delegatecalled.
User supplied couponEpoch indexes coupon balances during redemption.
Start gas snapshot determines the incentive amount that is minted to the sender.
Computed incentive value is minted, with fixed-point multiplications on gas and prices.
mintToAccount mutates global balance/debt state in _state.
vote reads and writes account and candidate state stored in _state.
redeemCoupons reads the DIP-13 cached price and coupon underlying balances.
advance is wrapped by the incentivized modifier which executes after the body.
advance triggers Regulator.step which calls oracleCapture.
commit calls upgradeTo, changing the proxy implementation.
emergencyCommit calls upgradeTo, changing the proxy implementation.
incentivized modifier calls mintToAccount for the caller reward.
incentivized modifier performs the dollar mint to msg.sender.
mintToAccount performs the external dollar().mint call.
mintToAccount invokes balanceCheck invariant.
increaseSupply routes part of new supply through mintToAccount-like paths.
initialize mints seed balances to designated accounts.
deposit makes an external transferFrom call into the token contract.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on the candidate, allowing arbitrary external code execution before finalization.
oracleCapture performs an external call to the oracle contract for price data.

Parameter used to index coupon balances within redeemCoupons.
Local snapshot feeding the incentive mint in the incentivized modifier.
